description: Confirms Dagster names exist in the installed version (with real signatures) and scans source for removed/deprecated/superseded Dagster API usage. Registers a resource and ships a stdio MCP server.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under.

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: Hard allow-list of tools (default: all). Valid: check_dagster_api, scan_source, scan_sources.

max_result_chars.label: Max Result Chars
max_result_chars.description: Upper bound on the serialized size of any tool result (a large source scan can otherwise be sizable).

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource under this key (python -m this module, with DAGSTER_API_CHECK_TOOLS_* env vars set from allow/max_result_chars). Any mcp_servers-aware component can then reference it via server_resource_key.

mcp_extra_env_vars.label: Mcp Extra Env Vars
mcp_extra_env_vars.description: mcp_server_resource_key only. Extra env var NAMES to copy into the spawned MCP server's env.
